headline_pain: Rent Going Up Again This Year?
primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." Sound familiar? You're not alone — hundreds of Melbourne west small businesses are trapped in the same cycle. But what if your monthly payment built equity instead of your landlord's retirement? New off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina, just 20km from Melbourne CBD near Princes Freeway, let you lock in today's price and stop the rent bleeding. Purpose-built for owner-occupiers, not investors. Stop paying dead money. Start owning your space.
description: Lock in today's price and turn rent into equity with a brand-new Truganina warehouse
